providerNote: Change ONLY this line to switch provider: "deepseek" or "gemini". Both keys can live in .secrets/ocr.env at the same time.

deepseek.note: The fast vision model occasionally spends its whole budget deliberating on a busy frame (a settled hand with cards on it) and returns nothing; fallbackModel is tried once after that, which turned the same frame into a reading. It is only reached after the primary fails.

gemini.note: Model id verified against this key on 2026-09-28: Google's API told us gemini-1.5-flash and gemini-2.5-flash are no longer served to this key and recommended gemini-3.8-flash. Gemini occasionally answers HTTP 503 under demand spikes; DeepSeek is the default for that reason. If an id is retired the error names it — list the ids available to the key at https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key=YOUR_KEY

scan.note: confirmDelaySeconds is the gap between the two reads. It was 1.5s, which straddled the moment the hand settles on the user's fast table so the reads disagreed (one saw the hand, the other saw nothing) and every hand was cancelled. 0.4s was measured to read hands live. minConfidence is the bar for SHOWING a reading; autoMinConfidence is the higher bar for Automatic to settle a bet with nobody looking.

keysLocation: casino-tracker/.secrets/ocr.env — never copy a key into this file or any other file in the repository
